name: Shenyang Aerospace University
supervisors: Liaoning Provincial Government (co-built with SASTIND, and with the Ministry of Education and AVIC)

evidence.summary: SAU describes itself as co-built by the Liaoning provincial government with the defence-industry regulator SASTIND.
It reports five defence-specialty disciplines (国防特色学科), two defence key and shortage majors and one national defence science and technology innovation team.

SAU says it is also co-built by Liaoning, the Ministry of Education and the state-owned aviation group AVIC, and describes serving national defence and the aviation and space industries as part of its mission.
